description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into Lever opportunities (candidates) via search-then-write. Lever supports an exact-match email filter, so this is a true upsert: a match gets tagged/staged/archived in place, a non-match gets a brand-new opportunity created.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one Lever opportunity (upserted via email match).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated / rows_errored / rows_skipped_no_key). No downstream data -- write side effect lands in Lever.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

email_column.label: Email Column
email_column.description: Upstream column holding the candidate's email -- the match key, searched via search_opportunities_by_email.

name_column.label: Name Column
name_column.description: Upstream column holding the candidate's full name. Used on CREATE only.

headline_column.label: Headline Column
headline_column.description: Upstream column holding the candidate's headline (e.g. current title/company). Used on CREATE only.

tags_column.label: Tags Column
tags_column.description: Upstream column holding tags (comma-separated string or list). Added via addTags on every row that has a match or gets created. ADDITIVE ONLY -- Lever has no 'replace all tags' call.

stage_id_column.label: Stage Id Column
stage_id_column.description: Upstream column holding a Lever stage ID. Updates stage on an existing match; included as 'stage' on create.

archive_reason_column.label: Archive Reason Column
archive_reason_column.description: Upstream column holding an archive reason. Only applies to an EXISTING matched opportunity -- never on create.

posting_id.label: Posting Id
posting_id.description: Static Lever posting ID, passed to create_opportunity only.

max_rows.label: Max Rows
max_rows.description: Overall safety cap on rows per run.

name: Lever Candidate Upsert
